report: PM COSMETICS HUB catalog enrichment audit
scope: Read-only audit of current evidence snapshot and six published reference-review CSV batches; no commercial product data or publication state changed.

evidence_snapshot.warning: Snapshot is older than this audit date and should be refreshed from the live Product Master before any publication decision.

reference_batches_audited.note: These are reference-source fields, not verified PM commercial fields. Source SKU, source price, source image, and source description must not be promoted to PM truth without matching and authorization.

safe_enrichment_rules: Use official brand/manufacturer pages to confirm product identity, size, usage, and product facts where available.
Write original PM Arabic descriptions; do not copy retailer descriptions verbatim.
Keep source retail price separate from PM-approved selling price; no currency conversion.
Do not use product images commercially until PM-owned or licensed usage is verified.
Do not create fake GTINs or treat retailer source SKU as PM SKU. Assign internal SKU only under the repository's approved SKU policy.
Require PM identity, stock, cost, image-rights and QA evidence before commercial publication.
Keep the commercial gate CLOSED until the live evidence snapshot and validation checks prove readiness.

example_verified_identity.official_facts_summary: Gentle hydrating facial cleanser for normal-to-dry skin; cleans without stripping natural moisture; contains ceramides and hyaluronic acid.

next_actions: Refresh staging-evidence.json from the live Product Master; do not rely on the 2026-10-05 snapshot for current stock.
Recover or generate the missing reference batches beyond batch-006; the six files inspected contain 1306 rows, not the 3479 target category rows.
Match each reference record to a PM-owned product record using exact brand, product name, size, and GTIN where available.
Fill categories and original descriptions only when identity is sufficiently confirmed; keep pricing and image fields in review state until PM approval and rights are documented.
Re-run catalog validation and preserve the global commercial gate until all required evidence passes.
